name: Bangladesh Post postcode booklet — Chattogram Division post offices (scan on post.rajshahi.gov.bd)
organization: বাংলাদেশ ডাক বিভাগ (Bangladesh Post Office) — DPMG Rajshahi Division portal
attribution: বাংলাদেশ ডাক বিভাগ (Bangladesh Post Office) — DPMG Rajshahi Division portal
notes: Same undated scanned booklet as the Rajshahi, Rangpur and Dhaka runs (no text layer). Chattogram Division's offices are in the booklet's 'চট্টগ্রাম রিজিয়ন': p. 15 (Brahmanbaria, Cumilla; the Sylhet-Division districts on pp. 14-15 are left out), pp. 16-17 (Chandpur, Lakshmipur, Noakhali, Feni, Chattogram GPO/port/city offices) and pp. 18-19 (Chattogram city and district, Khagrachhari, Rangamati, Bandarban, Cox's Bazar, up to the heading 'রাজশাহী রিজিয়ন'); only these were transcribed, by hand, from the page images (raw/*.png, PDF pages 9, 10 and 11 rotated). fetch.py verifies the PDF hash and re-emits the transcription. Four postcodes are partly faint and were read with the printed district range; four office names are uncertain readings (flagged). Branch post offices are not in the booklet. Licence: none stated on the source; treat as government public information, cite the source.
